title: Home-Site Lease Late-Fee Percentage by Late-Fee History
content:
The percentage applied to the unpaid amount of a Home-Site Lease late fee turns on the late fees already posted on the lease with an entry date in the trailing twelve calendar months.

| Late fees posted on the lease in the trailing twelve calendar months | Percentage applied to the unpaid amount |
|---|---|
| none | 4.5 percent |
| 3 or more | 7.0 percent |
| one or two | the lot class's late-fee percentage; no different percentage arises under this schedule |

**Where the rows divide**

- None against one: 4.5 percent against the lot class's late-fee percentage.
- Two against three: the lot class's late-fee percentage against 7.0 percent; three, four or more all give 7.0 percent.
- The count covers late fees posted on the lease's rent ledger by entry date within the trailing twelve calendar months; a late fee posted earlier does not count.

**Hypothetical applications** (unpaid amount 715.00)

| Late fees in the window | Percentage | Percentage of the unpaid amount |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 4.5 percent | 32.175, rounded half up to 32.18 |
| 3 | 7.0 percent | 50.05 |
